reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes Forsage-style participation by telling viewers to build a network for a lifetime benefit and linking higher program slots to earnings. The displayed BUSD upgrade requirement, receipt notifications, invitation controls, and partner and profit totals connect the represented financial rewards to recruiting or expanding a network.

citations.quote: These are the advantages of higher slots. That is, you will get earning from X Gold sometimes you will get earning from X Force
Build a small network in Farisit It will give you lifetime benefit
You have to get income from only one side

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker does not describe earnings as constant. Before walking through the programs, he says he will discuss “the loss,” then repeatedly qualifies when earnings occur with “sometimes.” That is a limited caution, not proof of a thorough risk disclosure, but it matters when deciding whether this is an unconditional promise. His stated purpose is to answer which of two platforms is better. Read together, the language supports a comparison of variable outcomes rather than a guaranteed-return pitch.

citations.quote: Many people tell me that which is better, Pharsage or Metaforce Today I am going to tell you whether Pharsage is better or Metaforce
let me tell you the loss. This is x3. Some times you will get earnings in it. Sometimes you will get earnings from x4.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution fairly identifies talk of higher slots and a network. But those quotes do not make the speaker’s qualified “sometimes” into a promise of payment every time. The dashboard images can show an upgrade option and a new-partner notification; neither image, by itself, establishes the terms under which a viewer would earn money. The opening therefore draws a stronger conclusion about the pitch than those particular observations require.

citations.quote: Sometimes you will get earnings from x4.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: “Sometimes” qualifies the timing of earnings, not the underlying invitation to participate. The speaker still tells viewers to build a network for a “lifetime benefit” and describes higher slots as advantageous sources of earnings. The brief reference to “loss” is not developed into a warning before that recommendation. The qualified phrasing does not undo the network-and-slot earning pitch.

opening.argument: Judge, the video opens as a question about which platform is better, then walks through the named programs and compares their structures. The speaker also points to a recent entry while explaining what he is seeing. Those are recognizable features of a firsthand interface demonstration: explaining categories, showing a dashboard, and comparing how two systems appear to work. An account of displayed earnings is not, on its own, an instruction for the viewer to pay or enroll. The better reading is a platform walkthrough with commentary, even if the speaker favors one option.

First let me show you about Pharsage one program is an X3, and another X4, XXX, and another X Gold but metaforce has only one program

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the network sentence as settling the purpose of the whole video. But it appears within an extended comparison of programs and their different income paths. Showing notifications or partner totals fits a demonstration of the interface as well as an endorsement. The cited visuals do not, without further explanation, establish that the speaker is instructing viewers to recruit through them.

citations.quote: but metaforce has only one program It has 12 slots not any other program

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A walkthrough can also promote what it demonstrates. Here the comparison culminates in an imperative to build a network for a lifetime benefit. The speaker calls higher slots advantageous because of their earnings, while the dashboard shows receipt notifications alongside a new-partner notification. Those details make the presentation more than a neutral account of interface features.

citations.quote: These are the advantages of higher slots. That is, you will get earning from X Gold sometimes you will get earning from X Force
Build a small network in Farisit It will give you lifetime benefit

opening.argument: Judge, a partner count and an invitation link do not, by themselves, distinguish a harmful recruitment scheme from an ordinary referral promotion. The dashboard visibly has invitation controls, partner totals, program slots, and an upgrade price. The speaker describes earnings from different programs and urges a small network, but the supplied material does not spell out a commission formula, show that a viewer must deposit funds to receive returns, or explain how a new partner’s arrival generates any particular receipt. The observed referral features warrant scrutiny; they do not establish every link in the alleged earning mechanism.

citations.quote: Some times you will get earnings in it. Sometimes you will get earnings from x4.
Build a small network in Farisit It will give you lifetime benefit

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution links a partner notification, receipts, and an upgrade control to a recruitment-based payout. That is a plausible concern, but the cited screens do not show a transaction trail from a newly joined partner to a particular payment, or the conditions for receiving one. Likewise, “build a small network” recommends participation without specifying that recruits’ payments fund the speaker’s earnings. The mechanism is being inferred from adjacent features rather than demonstrated.

citations.quote: Build a small network in Farisit It will give you lifetime benefit

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The case does not require a complete transaction trail or proof that any displayed receipt is genuine. The speaker connects building a network to a lifetime benefit and higher slots to additional earnings. The dashboard reinforces that pitch with priced upgrades, receipt notifications, and a new-partner notification. An ordinary-referral reading leaves that combined network-and-slot financial appeal unexplained.
